can-cook is covered (AC4.1-4.3) and the failed-cook path is covered (AC4.4), but R04's successful cook obligation — subtract all required quantities when sufficient, persist, and return {"cooked": NAME} — has no acceptance criterion asserting it.

cmd_can_cook returns the required can_cook/missing JSON without saving (store bytes unchanged); cmd_cook validates sufficiency first and only then subtracts all quantities, persists, and returns {"cooked": NAME}, matching R04.

cmd_cook never subtracts required quantities from pantry; it saves the unchanged store after the sufficiency check and reports {"cooked": NAME}, so cooked ingredients are not consumed, violating R04's "subtracts all required quantities... persists the result".
